title: Why the Roadmap Must Be a File
thesis: A plan that is not a file under version control is not a plan.

nodes.text: A plan lives where the work lives, or it is not read.

evidence.filled_by: the last three retrospectives: checked-in plans survived, wiki plans died
a file has a history; a wiki page erases its reasons

nodes.text: A file alone is not enough: plan and code drift silently, so the check must be mechanical.

evidence.filled_by: the 2024 script: stale entries from eleven to zero in a month

nodes.text: The forced-edit objection is true and does not matter; the check buys the impossibility of silent edits.

evidence.filled_by: a small forced edit is where a reviewer looks

nodes.text: The rule: file, next to the code, build fails on disagreement.
